verdict.rationale: Serving models over the local network is a fair question for a local-inference CLI and SDK, so the axis applies. The only documented OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint is the hosted Wally cloud API, and the docs state the on-device SDKs have no HTTP surface. Nothing shows a local server that other devices on the network can reach.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices
